title: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd - proposed acquisition of Southcorp Ltd.

body_sections.Summary: Foster's Group Limited proposes to acquire all remaining shares in Southcorp Limited.
body_sections.Market definition: For the purpose of competition analysis in this matter, the ACCC considered that the relevant markets were as follows: i. the production of wine in Australia; and ii. the wholesale supply of bottled wine in Australia.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Refer to the Public Competition Assessment attached below.
